Please check if you are running an incompatible [VPN client](https://docs.safing.io/portmaster/install/status/vpn-compatibility) or [software](https://docs.safing.io/portmaster/install/status/software-compatibility) and disable it. title: Manual DNS Setup Required

To fix this, you have to manually configure {{IP}} as the DNS Server in your system and in any conflicting application. This message will disappear some time after correct configuration.
你已禁用无缝 DNS 集成，因此 Portmaster 无法再可靠地保护你或过滤连接。要解决此问题，需要在系统和所有存在冲突的应用中手动将 {{IP}} 配置为 DNS 服务器。正确配置一段时间后，此提示会消失。

title: Configured DNS Servers Failing
已配置的 DNS 服务器不可用
message:
All configured DNS servers in Portmaster are failing.

You might not be able to connect to these servers, or all of these servers are offline.  
Choosing different DNS servers might fix this problem.

While the issue persists, Portmaster will use the DNS servers from your system or network, if permitted by configuration.

Alternatively, there might be something on your device that is interfering with Portmaster. This could be a firewall or another secure DNS resolver software. If that is your suspicion, please [check if you are running incompatible software here](https://docs.safing.io/portmaster/install/status/software-compatibility).

This notification will go away when Portmaster detects a working configured DNS server.

Portmaster 中配置的所有 DNS 服务器均不可用。

你可能无法连接到这些服务器，或者这些服务器全部离线。  
选择其他 DNS 服务器可能解决此问题。

在问题解决之前，如果配置允许，Portmaster 会使用系统或网络提供的 DNS 服务器。

也可能是设备上的其他程序正在干扰 Portmaster，例如防火墙或其他安全 DNS 解析软件。如果你怀疑存在这种情况，请[在此检查是否运行了不兼容的软件](https://docs.safing.io/portmaster/install/status/software-compatibility)。

当 Portmaster 检测到某个已配置的 DNS 服务器恢复正常后，此通知会消失。
